review-code.description: Run a comprehensive code review using the review-toolkit agents
review-code.template: Run a comprehensive code review of the current changes or files the user specifies. First call git status / git diff to determine scope (or use the files the user provided), then fan out the appropriate project agents from the review-toolkit in parallel: code-reviewer (always), silent-failure-hunter if error handling changed, pr-test-analyzer if test files changed, comment-analyzer if comments/docs changed, and type-design-analyzer if types changed. Launch all applicable agents concurrently via the Task tool, wait for every agent to return, then run code-simplifier only if all prior agents reported no critical issues. Aggregate findings into Critical Issues, Important Issues, Suggestions, Strengths, and a Recommended Action plan. Only report issues with confidence >= 80.
